page.layout: Two columns of Hebrew-Latin lexicon entries on one printed page. Left column: entries from יוֹר to יָדַע. Right column: entries from וַיִּדְּכָּאוּ to יֵדָעֻנּוּ. Page number top right. Running heads at top left and centre. Signature "S 3" at bottom left of the right column.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and dagesh marks are copied as far as they can be read at this scan size; several pointings are uncertain and may differ in detail from the printed forms. The left-hand running head reads as "י ד" and the centre head as "י ד"; both are small and may be misread. The first entry's Hebrew heading and the last line's Hebrew word are not fully certain. Printed headword lines run on to the next line in the scan (e.g. "ipsum,"); no words are missing from the text.
